issuing_body.why: The HLAB report calls them General Assembly resolutions; A/RES/79/325 lists it among 'its resolutions'.

status.why: Recalled by A/RES/79/325 in 2025; no stored text shows it withdrawn or replaced.

legal_force.why: UN General Assembly resolution; recommendatory by nature ('calls on', 'encourages'), consistent with the other UN resolution records.

summary_claims.claim: one of the two resolutions on AI the General Assembly adopted in 2024, with 78/265
summary_claims.locator: HLAB final report, paragraph 70, page 43: 'The two General Assembly resolutions on AI adopted in 2024 so far'

summary_claims.claim: the HLAB read the two as acknowledging that representation gaps in international AI governance need to be addressed
summary_claims.locator: HLAB final report, paragraph 70 (read against the stored text)

scope.note: Capacity-building resolution with limited safety content: AI appears in the title and the register's safety topic is international cooperation. Version 1 already carried it without a note; the precedents (an instrument with AI in the title whose content is mainly about something else) call for a scope_note.

note: Title, identifier, date and status are supported by A/RES/79/325 (un.org) and the HLAB report. The summary was cut to what those files show; it is short but supported. safety_topics has one value, below the minimum of two, because no stored file shows a second topic; the resolution's text is needed. I propose a scope_note, since the instrument is borderline under section 10.
